verdict.rationale: Alloy's only on-topic claim is marketing copy describing 'fully auditable agentic automation', which implies an audit capability for automated decisions. Nothing documents how a compliance officer would retrieve a timestamped decision log. Webhooks that fire when a manual review occurs are event notifications, not a retrievable audit trail, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented audit-trail retrieval (API or export), timestamps on decision records, coverage of human/manual reviewer decisions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can retrieve a timestamped audit trail of human and automated case decisions

citations.quote: Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
